description: The adapter drops optional decoder-selection tensors supported by the existing loader.
trigger: Transformers replaces a qualifying linear group whose checkpoint contains a nonzero mcg or mul1 decoder multiplier.
expected_behavior: Finalization should preserve the checkpoint's decoder parameters as Linear.load_exl3 does.
actual_behavior: Header discovery accepts the group, but Exl3HfLinear creates no mcg/mul1 buffers and finalize passes neither argument. LinearEXL3 consequently stores zero multipliers and passes those defaults to reconstruction or exl3_gemm instead of the checkpoint's values.

verification.description: Whole-parent constructor search found Linear.load_exl3 and Linear.convert_exl3; inspected both and compared them with the new discovery/finalization hooks. Quantizer output construction explicitly emits optional mcg/mul1 tensors.
verification.limits: Reach is limited to replaced linear groups using nondefault multipliers. Transformers may reject unexpected checkpoint tensors before forward; neither that loader behavior nor resulting numerical output was executed.
